description: Independent verification that the randomization schedule was loaded into the IRT correctly and that as-randomized assignments in the EDC reconcile to the master schedule (allocation, kit or treatment assignment, sentinel sequence). Performed by a statistician who did not generate the schedule.
inputs: Master randomization schedule; IRT load file; IRT randomization records; EDC randomization data
outputs: Randomization QC report; discrepancy log; sign-off
standard: ICH E9; ICH E3
qc: Independent double check; segregation of duties from the schedule generator.

deliverable: Emergency unblinding and code-break event log with reconciliation
description: Conduct-phase log of each emergency unblinding (who, when, participant, reason, authorization), reconciled against IRT code-break records and the safety database, with confirmation that the blinded team was not inadvertently unblinded.
inputs: IRT code-break records; safety database records; unblinding authorizations
outputs: Code-break event log; reconciliation memo; blinding-integrity statement
standard: ICH E6(R3); 21 CFR Part 11
qc: Independent verification; segregation from the blinded team.

deliverable: Protocol-deviation classification and reconciliation log (important versus non-important)
description: Conduct-phase deviation register with documented importance classification, reconciled between the clinical operations tracker, EDC deviation data and the analysis-population impact assessment, and reviewed while blinded.
inputs: Deviation tracker; EDC deviation data; protocol-defined deviation criteria
outputs: Classified deviation log; blinded review notes; map of deviations to analysis-set impact (source for SDTM DV)
standard: ICH E3; ICH E9; ICH E3 Q&As (R1)
qc: Blinded review with documented medical and biostatistics adjudication.

deliverable: Analysis-population derivation and participant-disposition reconciliation (population-flag QC)
description: Documents how each analysis set (for example randomized, safety, PK concentration, PK parameter, PD, per-protocol) is derived into ADSL flags, with the blinded allocation decisions, exclusion reasons, and QC that the flags reconcile to disposition, randomization, deviations and PK data.
inputs: ADSL; ADPP (PK evaluability); disposition; randomization; deviation classifications; data review decisions
outputs: Population derivation memo; ADSL flag QC; blinded allocation decision log
standard: ICH E9; ADaMIG v1.3; ICH M13A
qc: Independent double programming of the flags; blinded allocation sign-off.

deliverable: Data review meeting minutes and blinded data-review sign-off (pre-lock)
description: Minutes and decisions from the pre-lock data review meeting: disposition of outstanding queries, cleaning decisions, analysis-set and deviation determinations made while blinded, attendees and roles, and the formal go or no-go to lock.
inputs: Data review package; query status; deviation and analysis-set determinations
outputs: Signed minutes; decision log; blinded sign-off to proceed to lock
standard: ICH E9; ICH E6(R3)
qc: Attendees confirm the minutes; signatures retained with dates before unblinding.

deliverable: Database lock authorization and 21 CFR Part 11 audit-trail review records
description: Formal lock authorization memo plus evidence of the EDC audit-trail review (audit-trail completeness, electronic-signature manifest, lock and unlock records, access logs) supporting Part 11 compliance.
inputs: EDC audit trail; query closure status; electronic-signature records; lock checklist
outputs: Lock authorization memo; audit-trail review report; electronic-signature manifest
standard: 21 CFR Part 11; Electronic Systems, Electronic Records, and Electronic…; EMA/INS/GCP/112288/2023; ICH E6(R3)
qc: QA review of the audit trail; independent lock approval.

deliverable: PK sampling-time deviation and actual-versus-nominal time reconciliation (PK timing QC)
description: Reconciliation and QC of actual versus nominal sampling and dosing times feeding ADPC and NCA, including out-of-window collections and missing or repeat samples.
inputs: Actual collection and dosing date-times; nominal schedule; sampling windows from the PK analysis plan
outputs: Actual-versus-nominal time QC; out-of-window listing; confirmed timing inputs for ADPC
standard: ADNCA v1.0; SDTMIG v3.4; ICH M13A
qc: Independent check against source; PK scientist sign-off.

deliverable: BE analysis-set and period-exclusion derivations
description: ADaM derivations that flag each period and participant for the BE analysis: exclusions documented before bioanalysis (protocol violations, emesis, incomplete sampling) and exclusions that need concentrations (pre-dose concentration above 5% of that period's Cmax, very low exposure). They produce the BE analysis-set flag and the flags used by supplementary analyses.
inputs: BE analysis section of the SAP; deviation classification log with dates; ADPC and NCA results; emesis and dosing times.
outputs: Period-level exclusion flags with reasons in ADPP, BE analysis-set flag in ADSL, and a listing of excluded data for the CSR.
standard: ICH M13A; ICH M13A Guideline: Bioequivalence for Immediate-Release…; ADaMIG v1.3
qc: Independent double programming of the flags; each exclusion traced to a dated source record; check that protocol-violation exclusions predate bioanalysis.

deliverable: Drug interaction treatment-condition derivations
description: ADaM derivations that assign each object PK profile to its treatment condition (object alone or with the precipitant), check precipitant dosing before and during the profile against the protocol, pair profiles within participant, and flag profiles for the interaction analysis.
inputs: EX records for both drugs; ADPC and ADPP; DDI analysis section; protocol dosing schedule.
outputs: Treatment-condition and analysis flags with reasons in ADPP; listing of profiles with precipitant dosing deviations.
standard: ICH M12; ADaMIG v1.3
qc: Independent double programming of condition and flag logic; reconciliation to EX records.

deliverable: Per-cohort dose-escalation data package
description: The versioned set of safety listings and summaries, dosing data and preliminary PK that the Safety Review Committee reviews before each dose-escalation decision, built from a dated data snapshot under the charter's blinding rules. It covers every evaluable participant in the completed cohort, participants who stopped after at least one dose, and cumulative data from earlier cohorts.
inputs: Interim output specifications and data-cut procedure; committee charter decision rules; dated EDC snapshot (adverse events, vital signs, ECG, laboratory, dosing); preliminary PK summary; protocol definition of evaluable participants.
outputs: Package stamped with snapshot date and data status: cohort and cumulative safety summaries, listings, preliminary PK and exposure against protocol limits; input to the escalation decision record.
standard: EMEA/CHMP/SWP/28367/07 Rev. 1; ICH E3; ICH E6(R3)
qc: Risk-proportionate program QC (independent review or double programming of key safety summaries); snapshot date and data status on every output; participant counts reconciled to dosing records before release.

deliverable: Preliminary PK analysis and next-dose exposure projection
description: Preliminary noncompartmental PK on the concentrations available at the data cut, summarized by dose, with a projection of exposure at the next planned dose compared with the protocol's maximum exposure. It is labeled preliminary because it may rely on nominal times and unaudited bioanalytical results, and the final NCA supersedes it.
inputs: Preliminary bioanalytical results; dosing and sampling times; PK analysis plan rules for preliminary runs; observed dose-exposure data from completed cohorts; protocol maximum exposure and dose-increment limits.
outputs: Preliminary concentration listings and PK parameter summaries by dose; projected exposure at the next dose against the exposure limit; data-status label for the escalation package.
standard: EMEA/CHMP/SWP/28367/07 Rev. 1
qc: Second-person check of preliminary NCA settings and of the projection; preliminary label on every output; preliminary-to-final comparison kept for the CSR.

deliverable: Sentinel-dosing review record
description: Dated record of the review of all available data for the sentinel participants at the end of the protocol's observation period, and the decision to dose the rest of the cohort, hold or stop. It names the reviewers, the data and data cut reviewed and the stopping rules checked.
inputs: Sentinel participants' adverse events, vital signs, ECG and laboratory data through the observation period; protocol stopping rules; dosing times.
outputs: Signed, dated sentinel review record filed in the TMF; source for the CSR description of dose escalation.
standard: EMEA/CHMP/SWP/28367/07 Rev. 1; ICH E6(R3)
qc: Record timestamp checked against the first non-sentinel dose; reviewer roles match the protocol; any deviation documented.

deliverable: Dose-escalation decision record and escalation log
description: Minutes and decision for each escalation review (escalate, repeat, intermediate dose, de-escalate, stop or move to the next part), citing the package version reviewed and the charter rule applied, plus a running log of cohorts, doses, dates and decisions.
inputs: Per-cohort escalation packages; sentinel review records; charter decision and stopping rules; attendance and quorum.
outputs: Signed decision minutes per review; cumulative escalation log; source for the CSR description of dose selection and interim reviews, and for appendix 16.1.9 where provided.
standard: ICH E3; EMEA/CHMP/SWP/28367/07 Rev. 1; ICH E6(R3)
qc: Minutes approved by the committee; each decision traced to a package version and a charter rule; log reconciled to dosing records before database lock.

deliverable: Cumulative safety and PK summary for part transitions
description: Cumulative summary across all completed cohorts, prepared before a new study part starts (for example SAD to MAD, or adding a food-effect or patient cohort): adverse events by dose, laboratory, vital sign and ECG findings, and dose-exposure across cohorts against the protocol's maximum exposure.
inputs: All escalation packages and decision records to date; preliminary PK by dose; protocol part-transition criteria.
outputs: Cumulative tables and a dose-exposure figure with limits; input to the part-transition decision and, where needed, to a protocol amendment.
standard: EMEA/CHMP/SWP/28367/07 Rev. 1
qc: Independent check of cumulative counts against the individual packages; dose-exposure figure checked against preliminary PK listings.

deliverable: Meal-compliance and dosing-condition derivations
description: Derivations from meal and dosing records: fasting duration, meal start and end relative to dosing, meal completion and post-dose food restriction, giving flags that show whether each fed or fasted period met the protocol conditions and enters the food-effect analysis.
inputs: Meal and dosing CRF data; protocol fasting and meal-timing rules; food-effect analysis section of the SAP.
outputs: Period-level condition-compliance flags with reasons in ADaM; listing of noncompliant periods for the blinded data review and the CSR.
standard: Assessing the Effects of Food on Drugs in INDs and NDAs:…; ICH E6(R3)
qc: Independent double programming of the flags; spot-check against source meal records; listing reviewed at the blinded data review.

deliverable: Child-Pugh classification and unbound PK derivations
description: Derivation of the Child-Pugh score from its five components (encephalopathy, ascites, bilirubin, albumin, prothrombin time or INR), the impairment group, the assessment conditions, any reclassification closest to PK sampling, and unbound fraction and unbound PK parameters.
inputs: Screening and pre-dose laboratory values; clinical assessments of ascites and encephalopathy; protein-binding results; hepatic analysis section.
outputs: Score, component points and group in ADSL; unbound PK parameters in ADPP; listing of classification changes.
standard: Pharmacokinetics in Patients with Impaired Hepatic…; CPMP/EWP/2339/02
qc: Independent double programming of score and group; component values checked against source.

deliverable: Renal function classification, unbound PK and dialysis derivations
description: Derivations of baseline renal function by the protocol method (eGFR converted to mL/minute when required), renal function group, unbound fraction and unbound PK parameters, renal clearance from urine, and dialysate recovery and dialysis clearance for dialysis periods.
inputs: Serum creatinine and other markers required by the protocol equation; body size; protein-binding results; urine and dialysate concentrations and volumes; renal analysis section.
outputs: Renal function variables and group in ADSL; unbound and renal clearance parameters in ADPP; dialysis clearance.
standard: Pharmacokinetics in Patients with Impaired Renal…; Guideline on the evaluation of the pharmacokinetics of…
qc: Independent double programming of renal function and clearance derivations; spot-check against laboratory source.

deliverable: Analysis environment qualification and program setup (directory structure, validated software versions, run and seed control)
description: A qualified, version-locked execution environment for analysis programs, NCA software and modeling software, with documented versions, fixed seeds and a controlled directory structure that separates development from production. Establishes reproducibility before any production run.
inputs: Validation and QC plan; software validation records; SAP; programming specifications
outputs: Reproducible environment for TLF, NCA and modeling runs; version log
standard: ICH E9; ICH E6(R3); GAMP 5 Guide, 2nd Edition
qc: Installation and operational qualification records; environment checklist; version log; reviewer sign-off.

deliverable: Disposition tables (screened, randomized, dosed, completed or discontinued; analysis-set attribution)
description: Participant disposition by cohort or treatment: screened, enrolled, randomized, dosed, completed and discontinued with reasons, plus the number of participants in each analysis set.
inputs: ADSL; disposition data; SAP; TLF shells
outputs: CSR disposition displays (Section 10.1 and Section 14); analysis-set denominators for later tables
standard: ICH E3
qc: Independent double programming and reconciliation against the shells; analysis-set counts cross-checked to ADSL.

deliverable: Demographics and baseline characteristics tables
description: Age, sex, race, ethnicity, weight, height, BMI and other baseline characteristics by cohort or treatment and overall, in the safety set.
inputs: ADSL; SDTM DM, VS and MH where needed; SAP; TLF shells
outputs: CSR demographics displays (Section 11.2 and Section 14); covariate context for population PK
standard: ICH E3
qc: Independent double programming and reconciliation; statistics verified against ADSL.

deliverable: Exposure, dosing and treatment-compliance tables
description: Administered dose, dose level or cohort, duration of exposure, number of doses, dose modifications or interruptions, and compliance for multiple dosing, by treatment.
inputs: Exposure analysis dataset or SDTM EX; ADSL; SAP; TLF shells
outputs: CSR exposure and compliance sections; context for safety and PK interpretation
standard: ICH E3
qc: Independent double programming and reconciliation; dosing records cross-checked to EX.

deliverable: Protocol-deviation summary tables (with importance classification)
description: Protocol deviations by category and importance, by cohort or treatment, supporting per-protocol and analysis-set decisions.
inputs: SDTM DV; classified deviation log; ADSL; SAP; TLF shells
outputs: CSR protocol deviations section (Section 10.2) and Appendix 16.2.2 listing
standard: ICH E3
qc: Independent double programming and reconciliation; classifications checked against the blinded review decisions.

deliverable: PK concentration summary tables and mean concentration-time figures (linear and semi-log)
description: Descriptive statistics of concentrations by nominal time and dose or treatment (n, mean, SD, CV%, median, minimum, maximum, geometric mean), with mean and individual concentration-time profiles on linear and semi-log scales. BLQ values handled per the SAP.
inputs: ADPC; SDTM PC; BLQ and nominal versus actual time rules from the PK analysis plan; SAP; TLF shells
outputs: CSR PK concentration tables and figures; individual concentration listings (Appendix 16.2.5)
standard: ICH E3
qc: Independent double programming and reconciliation; BLQ handling verified; figures checked against the tables.

deliverable: Noncompartmental analysis (NCA) execution in validated software (PK parameter derivation)
description: NCA run in validated software to derive PK parameters (for example Cmax, Tmax, AUC0-t, AUC0-inf, percent AUC extrapolated, t1/2, lambda-z, CL/F, Vz/F) per the PK analysis plan, with documented lambda-z selection, BLQ handling, actual sampling times and exclusion rules. This run is the source of record for reported parameters.
inputs: ADPC (concentrations and actual times); dosing; PK analysis plan (parameter list, lambda-z, BLQ and exclusion rules); qualified environment
outputs: NCA parameters for SDTM PP and ADPP; parameter tables; modeling inputs
standard: ICH M13A; ICH E9
qc: Validated software is the source of record; independent recomputation of key parameters (second analyst or second tool) and reconciliation; lambda-z selection reviewed; run records archived.

deliverable: PK parameter (NCA) summary tables (Cmax, Tmax, AUC, t1/2, CL/F, Vz/F)
description: Descriptive statistics (n, arithmetic and geometric mean, SD, CV% and geometric CV%, median, minimum, maximum) of NCA parameters by dose or treatment, read from ADPP.
inputs: ADPP; ADSL; SAP and PK analysis plan; TLF shells
outputs: CSR PK parameter tables; inputs to dose-proportionality, accumulation and exposure-response work
standard: ICH E3; ICH M13A
qc: Independent double programming and reconciliation; values traceable to the NCA output of record.

deliverable: Dose-proportionality and accumulation analyses
description: Dose proportionality across dose levels (for example a power model with a confidence interval for the slope, or analysis of dose-normalized exposure) and accumulation ratios for Cmax and AUC between the first dose and steady state with multiple dosing, with supporting figures.
inputs: ADPP; SAP and PK analysis plan; TLF shells
outputs: CSR sections on linearity, accumulation and time dependence
standard: ICH E3
qc: Independent double programming and reconciliation; model specification reviewed; outputs traced to ADPP.

deliverable: Food-effect, DDI and relative BA or BE statistical analysis (ANOVA, 90% CI, geometric mean ratio)
description: Crossover or parallel analysis of log-transformed Cmax and AUC with the prespecified linear or mixed model: geometric mean ratio (test or treatment over reference) with 90% confidence interval, compared with acceptance limits where the design requires them, for food-effect, drug-drug interaction, or relative bioavailability and bioequivalence studies.
inputs: ADPP; ADSL (period and sequence); SAP; TLF shells
outputs: CSR comparison section; exposure ratios for dosing and labeling decisions
standard: ICH M13A; Statistical Approaches to Establishing Bioequivalence; Assessing the Effects of Food on Drugs in INDs and NDAs:…; ICH M12; Bioavailability Studies Submitted in NDAs or INDs:…
qc: Independent double programming of the model, ratio and 90% CI with reconciliation; model statement reviewed; values traced to ADPP.

deliverable: Concentration-QTc (C-QTc) and QT/QTc analysis
description: Cardiodynamic analysis: categorical QTc outlier and change-from-baseline summaries plus a prespecified concentration-QTc mixed-effects model (slope and predicted placebo-corrected change in QTc at relevant exposures, with two-sided 90% confidence intervals), per the cardiodynamic analysis plan.
inputs: ADEG (time-matched QTc); ADPC; SAP or cardiodynamic analysis plan
outputs: CSR QT and cardiodynamic section; concentration-QTc evidence for regulatory decisions
standard: ICH E14; ICH E14/S7B Q&As (R1)
qc: Independent re-modeling or double programming with reconciliation; model assumptions reviewed; run records archived.

deliverable: Population PK and exposure-response modeling with run records
description: Population PK model building (structural, statistical and covariate models) and exposure-response or exposure-safety analyses in nonlinear mixed-effects software, with parameter estimates and precision, diagnostic plots, visual predictive checks, covariate effects and simulations, plus complete archived run records (control files, run log, seeds, datasets).
inputs: Modeling dataset built from ADPC, ADSL and dosing data per its specification; modeling analysis plan; NCA results where used
outputs: Pharmacometrics analysis report; CSR modeling section; dose-selection inputs
standard: Population Pharmacokinetics: Guidance for Industry; Exposure-Response Relationships: Study Design, Data…; CHMP/EWP/185990/06
qc: Run records (control files, seeds, logs) archived; independent review of model code and assumptions; key results reproduced; diagnostics reviewed.

deliverable: Safety TLFs: TEAEs (overview, by SOC and PT, severity, relationship, by dose)
description: Treatment-emergent adverse event overview and summaries by MedDRA SOC and PT, maximum severity, relationship to study drug, and dose or cohort, with adverse event listings.
inputs: ADAE; SDTM AE; ADSL; SAP; TLF shells
outputs: CSR adverse event section and Appendix 16.2.7 listings; safety review committee data
standard: ICH E3; MedDRA Version 29.1
qc: Independent double programming and reconciliation; TEAE flag verified; counts cross-checked to ADAE.

deliverable: Safety TLFs: deaths, SAEs and AEs leading to discontinuation
description: Summaries and listings of deaths, serious adverse events and adverse events leading to dose modification or withdrawal, by dose or treatment; the source for narratives.
inputs: ADAE (seriousness, death and action variables); ADSL; SAP; TLF shells
outputs: CSR deaths, serious and other significant adverse events section; narrative source; safety review committee data
standard: ICH E3; 21 CFR Part 312
qc: Independent double programming and reconciliation; serious adverse event and death flags reconciled with the safety database.

deliverable: Safety TLFs: clinical laboratory analyses (summary, change from baseline, shift tables, outliers, Hy's law)
description: Laboratory summaries and change from baseline by visit, shift tables (normal range or toxicity grade), markedly abnormal value listings, and liver test evaluation for potential Hy's law cases (for example a plot of peak ALT against peak total bilirubin), by dose or treatment.
inputs: ADLB; SDTM LB; reference ranges; ADSL; SAP; TLF shells
outputs: CSR clinical laboratory section (Section 12.4); safety review committee data
standard: ICH E3; Drug-Induced Liver Injury: Premarketing Clinical Evaluation; CTCAE v6.0 (MedDRA 28.0)
qc: Independent double programming and reconciliation; reference-range and grade derivations verified.

deliverable: Safety TLFs: vital signs, 12-lead ECG parameters and physical examination
description: Vital signs summaries, change from baseline and outliers; ECG interval summaries (heart rate, PR, QRS, QT, QTcF, QTcB) with change from baseline and categorical outlier tables; and physical examination findings; by dose or treatment.
inputs: ADVS; ADEG; SDTM VS, EG and PE; ADSL; SAP; TLF shells
outputs: CSR vital signs, physical findings and other safety observations section (Section 12.5)
standard: ICH E3; ICH E14
qc: Independent double programming and reconciliation; baseline, change and outlier criteria verified.

deliverable: PD endpoint analyses (biomarker and target-engagement summaries and PK/PD)
description: Descriptive or model-based summaries of pharmacodynamic endpoints and biomarkers (absolute values, change and percent change from baseline) by dose or treatment and time, plus prespecified exploratory PK/PD relationships.
inputs: ADPD; ADPC; SAP or PK/PD analysis plan; TLF shells
outputs: CSR pharmacodynamics section; PK/PD and dose-selection inputs
standard: ICH E3
qc: Independent double programming and reconciliation; derivations and units verified; PK/PD models reviewed.

deliverable: Immunogenicity and anti-drug antibody (ADA) analyses
description: ADA incidence and prevalence (treatment-emergent ADA, titers, neutralizing antibodies) by treatment and time, and the impact of ADA status on PK, PD and safety, per the immunogenicity analysis plan.
inputs: Immunogenicity analysis dataset; SDTM IS; bioanalytical ADA results; SAP
outputs: CSR immunogenicity section; assessment of ADA impact on PK
standard: SDTMIG v3.4
qc: Independent double programming and reconciliation; treatment-emergent ADA derivation verified.

deliverable: Exploratory and post hoc analyses
description: Prespecified exploratory analyses and post hoc analyses (subgroups, special populations, additional PK, PD or safety explorations), each clearly labeled as exploratory or post hoc in the outputs and the CSR.
inputs: ADaM datasets; SAP or SAP addendum; post hoc requests documented after unblinding
outputs: CSR exploratory section; hypotheses for later studies
standard: ICH E9; ICH E3
qc: Risk-based QC, with key exploratory outputs double programmed; labeling reviewed.

deliverable: Statistical analysis execution (run-all production of SAP-specified analyses)
description: Controlled production run of all SAP-specified programs against the locked, unblinded analysis datasets in the qualified environment, generating the complete TLF package with logged, reproducible runs.
inputs: Locked ADaM datasets; final SAP; programming specifications; TLF shells; qualified environment
outputs: Full TLF package; outputs for the CSR and for QC reconciliation
standard: ICH E9; ICH E6(R3)
qc: Log review (no errors or unexplained warnings); output-versus-shell check; double-programming reconciliation before release.

deliverable: Independent double-programming QC and reconciliation (discrepancy resolution)
description: Independent re-creation of key outputs by a second programmer, and independent recomputation of PK parameters, with formal comparison of production and QC results until reportable values agree; discrepancies investigated and resolved.
inputs: Production outputs; independent QC programs; validation and QC plan; SAP
outputs: Reconciled, release-ready outputs; discrepancy log; QC sign-off
standard: ICH E6(R3); ICH E9
qc: This is the QC step: independent double programming with documented reconciliation; lead biostatistician sign-off.

deliverable: TLF validation and QC documentation with discrepancy log
description: Per-output QC records: validation method (independent double programming, peer review, log review), QC status, discrepancies found and resolved, reviewer and date; the audit-ready evidence that each output was checked.
inputs: Double-programming results; reconciliation outcomes; validation and QC plan
outputs: QC documentation package; inspection-ready evidence of output QC
standard: EMA/INS/GCP/112288/2023; 21 CFR Part 11
qc: Completeness and consistency review of the QC records; lead biostatistician sign-off.

deliverable: Blind data review meeting and documented decisions (before unblinding)
description: Final review of the locked analysis datasets before unblinding: confirms analysis-set assignments, deviation classifications, PK exclusions (for example aberrant concentrations or unreliable terminal phases) and any SAP clarifications, all decided while blinded and minuted.
inputs: Blinded review listings; deviation log; PK profile review; draft analysis sets; SAP
outputs: Signed decisions and minutes; final analysis sets and exclusions; authorization to unblind
standard: ICH E9; ICH E6(R3)
qc: Decisions documented before unblinding; cross-functional sign-off; decisions locked.

deliverable: Unblinding and code-break execution
description: Controlled, authorized release of the randomization codes after lock and the blinded decisions: treatment codes applied to the analysis datasets, with documented authorization, timing and access control.
inputs: Locked database; signed blind review decisions; randomization schedule or code list; unblinding plan
outputs: Unblinded analysis datasets; treatment-resolved outputs; audit-trail entry; codes for CSR Appendix 16.1.7
standard: ICH E6(R3); ICH E3; 21 CFR Part 11
qc: Authorization and timing documented; access-controlled execution; audit trail; segregation of duties verified.

deliverable: Pharmacometrics (population PK) analysis report
description: Standalone modeling report covering objectives, data, methods, model development, results, diagnostics, simulations and conclusions, with run records appended; supports the CSR and dose selection.
inputs: Modeling run records and outputs; modeling analysis plan; NCA results
outputs: CSR modeling section or appendix; dose-selection rationale; submission modeling package
standard: Population Pharmacokinetics: Guidance for Industry; CHMP/EWP/185990/06; ICH M15
qc: Independent review of model and report; key results reproduced; run-record completeness check.

deliverable: QC documentation and validation records package (analysis stage)
description: Consolidated validation evidence for the analysis: environment qualification, per-output QC records, reconciliations, NCA and modeling run records, seed and version logs, and reviewer sign-offs; the inspection-ready validation file.
inputs: Environment qualification; per-output QC records; reconciliation logs; NCA and modeling run records
outputs: Validation file for the trial master file and inspection readiness
standard: EMA/INS/GCP/112288/2023; 21 CFR Part 11
qc: Completeness and traceability review; lead biostatistician sign-off; archived per the retention policy.

deliverable: Independent NCA verification record (parameter-derivation QC)
description: Independent QC of the NCA run itself: lambda-z point selection, percent AUC extrapolated, partial-area definitions, BLQ handling and parameter reproducibility, checked by a second PK scientist or a second tool and documented as a discrete record.
inputs: ADPC; NCA settings and profiles; lambda-z selection rationale
outputs: NCA QC checklist; lambda-z review; parameter reproducibility sign-off
standard: ICH M13A; ICH E9
qc: Independent PK reviewer; documented parameter verification.

deliverable: Pharmacometrics model qualification and validation records (covariate selection, goodness of fit, VPC, bootstrap, run log)
description: The model-development audit trail behind the modeling report: run log, version-controlled control files, goodness-of-fit and diagnostic plots, visual predictive checks, bootstrap or other uncertainty assessments, covariate-selection justification and final-model qualification, reviewed by an independent pharmacometrician.
inputs: Modeling dataset; control files; run records; diagnostics
outputs: Model run log; diagnostic package; qualification memo
standard: Population Pharmacokinetics: Guidance for Industry
qc: Independent pharmacometrics review; reproducible run records.

deliverable: Risk-based QC plan execution and QC-level assignment matrix (per-output QC tiering)
description: Documented assignment of a QC level to each dataset and output (full independent double programming, review-level QC or visual check) with its rationale, plus evidence that the assigned level was carried out for each output.
inputs: TLF inventory; criticality and risk assessment; validation and QC plan; QC records
outputs: QC-level assignment matrix; evidence of the QC performed per output
standard: ICH E6(R3); ICH E8(R1)
qc: QC lead sign-off; independent double programming required for outputs assigned the highest QC level.

deliverable: Concentration-QTc (C-QTc) model assumption checks and QC record
description: Supporting diagnostics and QC for the concentration-QTc model: tests of model assumptions, hysteresis assessment (by-time-point plots and hysteresis loop plots), goodness of fit, coverage of the observed concentration range, and QC of the mixed-effects fit.
inputs: Time-matched concentration and QTc data; prespecified model and selection criteria
outputs: Assumption-check report; model QC record; outputs for regulatory review
standard: ICH E14/S7B Q&As (R1)
qc: Independent review by a second statistician or pharmacometrician.

deliverable: Post-unblinding data change and analysis deviation log
description: Running record, from unblinding to CSR finalization, of every data change made after unblinding and every departure from the final SAP implemented without an SAP amendment: what changed, why, when, who authorized it and what data were available at the time. SAP revisions themselves stay in the SAP amendment and version-control log.
inputs: Final SAP and its amendment log; programming change requests; data change requests after unblinding; review comments on outputs.
outputs: Signed change log; source for the CSR section on changes in planned analyses and for appendix 16.1.9.
standard: ICH E3; ICH E6(R3); ICH E9
qc: Periodic review by a second statistician; each entry traced to a program or output change; reconciled with the CSR methods before sign-off.

deliverable: Relative or absolute bioavailability results
description: Presentation set built on the primary GMRs and 90% CIs: geometric and arithmetic means for AUC(0-t), AUC(0-inf) and Cmax for each prespecified comparison, within- and between-participant variability, Tmax summaries and, with an intravenous reference, absolute bioavailability.
inputs: ADPP; primary comparative analysis; BA analysis section of the SAP; TLF shells.
outputs: BA result tables and figures for the CSR; inputs to formulation decisions and to later biopharmaceutic summaries.
standard: Bioavailability Studies Submitted in NDAs or INDs:…; ICH M4E(R2)
qc: Independent double programming of the summary and variability tables; values traced to ADPP.

deliverable: Clinical relevance assessment when bioavailability similarity is not shown
description: When the confidence interval for a formulation comparison falls outside the predefined limits, an assessment using available dose-response or concentration-response data of whether the difference in rate or extent of absorption matters for safety or efficacy, with the resulting recommendation.
inputs: BA results; exposure-response or dose-response models and data; clinical safety data.
outputs: Assessment memo or report section with a recommendation (no meaningful impact, dose adjustment, reformulation or further study).
standard: Bioavailability Studies Submitted in NDAs or INDs:…
qc: Independent pharmacometrics review; model assumptions and simulations documented and reproducible.

deliverable: Reference-scaled BE analysis for a highly variable drug (replicate design)
description: Analysis of a partial or full replicate crossover that estimates the within-participant variability of the reference product and applies the prespecified reference-scaled criterion of the target region, with its point-estimate constraint, alongside the average BE result.
inputs: Replicate-design ADPP; SAP reference-scaling rules and regulatory constants; outlier handling plan.
outputs: Tables of the reference within-participant SD (sWR), the scaled criterion or widened limits, GMR with 90% CI and point estimate; analyses with and without statistical outliers where requested.
standard: Statistical Approaches to Establishing Bioequivalence; Guideline on the investigation of bioequivalence; Considerations regarding the implementation of ICH M13A…
qc: Independent double programming of sWR, the scaled criterion and the point estimate; regulatory constants checked against the cited guidance.

deliverable: BE supplementary and sensitivity analyses
description: Prespecified analyses that test the robustness of the BE conclusion: excluded periods restored, participants with Cmax at the first post-dose sample removed, alternative missing-data handling, group-by-formulation exploration in multi-group studies, and potency-corrected results when correction is prespecified.
inputs: BE analysis section of the SAP; BE exclusion flags; ADPP; group or site assignments; assayed potency of test and comparator batches if correction is prespecified.
outputs: Supplementary GMR and 90% CI tables naming the participants removed or restored; text for the CSR discussion of robustness.
standard: ICH M13A; Statistical Approaches to Establishing Bioequivalence
qc: Same validation level as the primary analysis for each supplementary table; each analysis marked as prespecified or post hoc.

deliverable: BE presentation set: ANOVA tables, individual ratios and profiles
description: The BE-specific tables, listings and figures that accompany the primary GMR table: individual concentrations and parameters by formulation with summary statistics, individual linear and log-linear profiles on actual times, mean profiles on nominal times, ANOVA tables testing all model effects, and individual test/reference ratios by sequence.
inputs: ADPC, ADPP and the primary BE analysis; BE exclusion flags; TLF shells; randomization scheme.
outputs: BE TLFs for the CSR body and appendices; listings that let a reviewer repeat the analysis.
standard: ICH M13A; Statistical Approaches to Establishing Bioequivalence
qc: Independent double programming of the ANOVA tables and individual ratios; figures checked against listings; completeness check against the M13A presentation items.

deliverable: Drug interaction results: GMR, forest plot and inhibitor or inducer classification
description: DDI presentation set built on the primary GMRs and 90% CIs: the range of individual ratios; forest, spaghetti or individual-ratio plots; the proportion of participants beyond the no-effect boundary; and, with a sensitive index CYP substrate, classification of the investigational drug as a strong, moderate or weak CYP inhibitor or inducer. ICH M12 has no such classification for transporters or non-CYP enzymes.
inputs: Primary comparative analysis; ADPP with treatment-condition flags; DDI analysis section; TLF shells.
outputs: DDI TLFs and interpretation text for the CSR; inputs to labeling and to concomitant-medication rules in later protocols.
standard: ICH M12
qc: Independent double programming of individual-ratio tables and plots; classification checked against the M12 CYP thresholds.

deliverable: Fed versus fasted results and labeling support
description: Food-effect presentation set built on the primary fed/fasted GMRs and 90% CIs: individual values and summary statistics for all derived parameters, Tmax and Tlag summaries and overlaid mean profiles, with the interpretation needed for the effect-of-food statement in labeling.
inputs: Primary comparative analysis; ADPP with condition-compliance flags; food-effect analysis section; TLF shells.
outputs: Food-effect TLFs and interpretation text for the CSR; input to labeling and dosing instructions.
standard: Assessing the Effects of Food on Drugs in INDs and NDAs:…; ICH M4E(R2)
qc: Independent double programming of the summary tables; interpretation checked against the prespecified criterion.

deliverable: Hepatic impairment results: PK by Child-Pugh group and dosing support
description: Geometric and arithmetic means and variability by group, GMRs with 90% CIs versus control for total and unbound AUC and Cmax, plots of PK against classification components, and simulations or no-effect boundary comparisons that support dosing recommendations.
inputs: ADPP and ADSL with hepatic variables; hepatic analysis section.
outputs: Hepatic TLFs and dosing-support analyses for the CSR and labeling.
standard: Pharmacokinetics in Patients with Impaired Hepatic…; CPMP/EWP/2339/02
qc: Independent double programming of GMR tables and plots.

deliverable: Thorough QT by-time-point analysis and assay sensitivity
description: For a thorough QT study: baseline- and placebo-adjusted QTc by time point with the largest time-matched mean effect and its one-sided 95% upper bound, the positive-control analysis that shows assay sensitivity, and categorical QTc tables.
inputs: ADEG with replicate-averaged QTc; cardiodynamic analysis plan; TLF shells.
outputs: By-time-point and positive-control tables and figures; categorical tables; inputs to the cardiodynamic report.
standard: ICH E14; ICH E14/S7B Q&As (R1)
qc: Independent double programming of time-matched estimates and the positive-control analysis.

deliverable: Cardiodynamic analysis report
description: Report of the QT assessment: ECG methods and quality, model development and diagnostics (including hysteresis and goodness of fit), the predicted placebo-adjusted QTc effect with 90% CI at therapeutic and high clinical exposures, categorical findings and, for a thorough QT study, assay sensitivity, with the conclusion stated against the E14 criteria.
inputs: Concentration-QTc analysis outputs and assumption-check records; by-time-point and positive-control outputs for a thorough QT study; reader-variability results.
outputs: Cardiodynamic report appended to the CSR; summary text for the CSR and later submissions.
standard: ICH E14/S7B Q&As (R1); ICH E14
qc: Independent pharmacometrics review; key estimates reproduced from archived run records.

deliverable: Renal impairment results: PK versus renal function and dosing support
description: Regression estimates and plots of individual PK parameters against renal function, descriptive statistics and GMRs versus control by group (total and unbound), dialysis results, and simulations or no-effect boundary comparisons that support any dose adjustment.
inputs: ADPP and ADSL with renal variables; renal analysis section; exposure-response information.
outputs: Renal TLFs and dosing-support analyses for the CSR and labeling.
standard: Guideline on the evaluation of the pharmacokinetics of…; Pharmacokinetics in Patients with Impaired Renal…
qc: Independent double programming of regression and GMR tables; simulations reproducible from archived code.

deliverable: CSR statistical methods sections (ICH E3 Sections 9.7 and 11.4.2)
description: Description of the statistical and PK methods as actually executed: analysis sets, estimands and intercurrent-event strategies, handling of missing and BLQ data, nominal versus actual times, summary conventions, NCA methods and software, any modeling, comparative PK and concentration-QTc methods, interim or committee rules, and every change from the SAP with its timing relative to unblinding.
inputs: Final SAP and amendments; SAP change log; protocol and estimands; final TLFs; NCA and modeling run records; reviewer guides.
outputs: Methods text for the CSR body; basis for Appendix 16.1.9; anchor for the results text and synopsis.
standard: ICH E3; ICH E9(R1); ICH M13A
qc: Second-biostatistician review against the final SAP; check that every method maps to a reported output; medical-writer editorial QC; SAP-to-CSR methods reconciliation checklist.

deliverable: CSR in-text tables and figures
description: Condensed tables and figures placed in the CSR body: disposition, demographics, exposure, key PK concentration and parameter summaries, mean concentration-time figures, dose proportionality, comparative PK ratios with confidence intervals, concentration-QTc and key safety summaries. They are abridged from the full Section 14 outputs and produced by the same validated programs from the locked datasets.
inputs: Locked ADaM datasets; QC-passed full TLFs; NCA and modeling results; in-text shell specifications.
outputs: In-text tables and figures in the CSR results sections; values cited in the results text and synopsis.
standard: ICH E3
qc: Independent double programming or one-to-one reconciliation of every in-text value against the full TLF and source dataset; QC log signed.

deliverable: Biostatistics contribution to and review of the CSR draft (results text, consistency review)
description: Biostatistics-authored results text for disposition, PK, PD and safety, plus a structured review of the integrated CSR draft: statistical and PK statements are correct and not over-interpreted, estimand and analysis-set language is consistent, and every number in the text ties to a table. It includes resolution of medical-writing and clinical comments on statistical content.
inputs: CSR draft from medical writing; in-text and full TLFs; ADaM datasets; SAP and SAP change log; review comments.
outputs: Marked-up CSR draft; statistical review sign-off; findings log; clearance for finalization.
standard: ICH E3; ICH E9
qc: Documented number-by-number consistency check (CSR, TLF, dataset); second-reviewer spot check; comment-resolution log kept as a controlled record.

deliverable: CSR Appendix 16.1.9: documentation of statistical methods, including the final SAP
description: Compiled Appendix 16.1.9: the final approved SAP with version history and amendments, the PK analysis plan when separate, output shells, further statistical documentation, and the record of changes from the SAP. It is the auditable record of how the analyses were specified and executed.
inputs: Final SAP and amendments; PK analysis plan; shells; SAP change log; version-control records; CSR methods text.
outputs: Appendix 16.1.9 of the CSR; reviewer-facing methods documentation in the submission.
standard: ICH E3; 21 CFR Part 11
qc: Completeness and version reconciliation (approved versions only); cross-check of SAP content against the CSR methods; QA review of the appendix assembly.

deliverable: CSR Appendix 16.2: participant data listings
description: By-participant data listings under ICH E3 Section 16.2: discontinued participants, protocol deviations, participants excluded from analysis, demographics, compliance and drug concentration data, individual efficacy or PK response data, adverse events, and individual laboratory measurements, generated from locked data by validated programs.
inputs: Locked SDTM and ADaM datasets; Section 16.2 listing specifications and shells.
outputs: Appendix 16.2 listings; source for safety narratives and participant profiles.
standard: ICH E3; ICH M13A
qc: Independent double programming or QC review of each listing; reconciliation against the summary TLFs; QC log.

deliverable: CSR and submission appendices: Define-XML, reviewer guides (cSDRG, ADRG) and annotated CRF
description: Packaging of the SDTM and ADaM Define-XML, the clinical study data reviewer's guide (cSDRG), the analysis data reviewer's guide (ADRG) and the annotated CRF as CSR appendices and Module 5 components, so the datasets are reviewer-ready and traceable.
inputs: Final SDTM and ADaM Define-XML; cSDRG and ADRG; annotated CRF; final conformance report.
outputs: Define-XML and reviewer guides packaged with the datasets in Module 5 and referenced by the CSR.
standard: Define-XML v2.1; PHUSE cSDRG Package; PHUSE ADRG Package; Study Data Technical Conformance Guide: Technical…
qc: Conformance re-run on the final datasets; reviewer-guide completeness check; Define-XML versus dataset consistency check.

deliverable: Safety narrative data support
description: Programming support for ICH E3 narratives of deaths, serious adverse events and other significant adverse events: structured per-participant extracts (demographics, dosing, event timing, severity and relationship, relevant laboratory, vital sign and ECG data, concomitant medications) for medical writers, and QC that narrative facts match the data.
inputs: Locked SDTM and ADaM data; Section 16.2 listings; participant profiles; narrative trigger list.
outputs: Per-participant narrative data packages; QC anchor for narrative text.
standard: ICH E3
qc: Narrative-to-source reconciliation per participant; independent check that the trigger list captures all deaths and serious adverse events; QC log.

deliverable: Participant profiles
description: Per-participant integrated profiles, tabular or graphical, that bring dosing, PK sampling and concentrations, adverse events, laboratory, vital sign, ECG and PD data onto one timeline for medical review, narrative support and data-cleaning confirmation.
inputs: Locked SDTM and ADaM data across domains; profile specification or template; Section 16.2 listings.
outputs: Participant profiles for medical review and narrative authoring.
standard: ICH E3
qc: Spot check of profiles against source listings; independent review of the profile program; reconciliation against ADaM.

deliverable: Submission datasets and analysis programs (with the reviewer guides)
description: Final, submission-ready SDTM and ADaM datasets as XPT version 5 transport files, with the programs that created the ADaM datasets and key outputs, packaged for Module 5 with Define-XML and the reviewer guides. Programs are provided as text files with software versions stated in the ADRG, following the FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide.
inputs: Locked, conformance-checked SDTM and ADaM datasets; validated analysis and TLF programs; Define-XML; reviewer guides.
outputs: Module 5 dataset and program package supporting the CSR; analyses a reviewer can follow and reproduce.
standard: Study Data Technical Conformance Guide: Technical…; FDA Validator Rules v1.6; SDTMIG v3.4; ADaMIG v1.3
qc: Final conformance check; independent double-programming evidence retained; program readability and executability review; traceability from collected data to outputs confirmed.

deliverable: Traceability matrix (raw data to SDTM, ADaM, TLF and CSR)
description: End-to-end traceability linking collected data and the annotated CRF to SDTM variables, SDTM to ADaM derivations, ADaM to each TLF, and TLFs to the numbers reported in the CSR, showing analysis-set and value-level provenance for reviewers and inspectors. It extends the Stage 3 raw-to-ADaM matrix to outputs and report text.
inputs: Annotated CRF; SDTM and ADaM specifications and Define-XML (including value-level metadata); TLF specifications; raw-to-ADaM traceability matrix; CSR in-text mapping.
outputs: Traceability matrix supporting the reviewer guides and CSR consistency; inspection-readiness record.
standard: ADaMIG v1.3; Define-XML v2.1
qc: Independent verification that each CSR and TLF number traces to a derivation and source; gap review; QA audit.

deliverable: Numerical consistency QC: CSR versus TLFs versus datasets
description: Formal, documented check that every number in the CSR body, synopsis and in-text tables matches the corresponding full TLF and source dataset, and the validated NCA or modeling output for PK. It produces a discrepancy log closed to zero open critical findings before CSR finalization.
inputs: CSR draft and synopsis; in-text and full TLFs; ADaM datasets; NCA and modeling outputs.
outputs: Signed numerical-consistency QC report and discrepancy log; release gate for the CSR.
standard: ICH E3
qc: An independent reviewer performs the check; discrepancy log tracked to closure; second-level QA sign-off.

deliverable: Statistical input to the CSR synopsis and briefing documents
description: Statistical content for the CSR synopsis and for regulatory briefing documents: a concise account of design, estimands and analysis sets with the key PK, PD and safety results, consistent word for word with the CSR and TLFs.
inputs: Final CSR results and TLFs; SAP and methods text; NCA and modeling results; prior briefing materials.
outputs: Synopsis statistical text; briefing-document statistical sections; input to the design of the next study.
standard: ICH E3
qc: Consistency check against the CSR body and TLFs (identical numbers); peer and medical review; sign-off.

deliverable: Biostatistics sign-off and CSR release for submission
description: Final documented biostatistics approval that the CSR statistical content, TLFs, datasets, reviewer guides and traceability are complete, consistent and inspection-ready, releasing the package for eCTD assembly. It records the software and version used for each deliverable.
inputs: Final CSR; TLFs; submission datasets and programs; Define-XML; reviewer guides; QC and consistency logs; traceability matrix.
outputs: Approved, locked CSR statistical package for Module 5.
standard: 21 CFR Part 11
qc: Final QA review; confirmation that all discrepancy logs are closed; electronic signature with audit trail; software and version records attached.

deliverable: eCTD Module 5 study-data package assembly and conformance (reviewer guide bundle, study tagging)
description: Packaging of the study-data artifacts into eCTD Module 5: folder structure per the FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide, placement of SDTM, ADaM, Define-XML, reviewer guides and programs, package-level conformance validation, and consistency with the Study Data Standardization Plan.
inputs: Released SDTM and ADaM datasets, Define-XML, reviewer guides and programs; Study Data Standardization Plan.
outputs: Assembled Module 5 study-data package; package-level conformance report.
standard: Study Data Technical Conformance Guide: Technical…; ICH M4(R4); ICH eCTD v3.2.2; FDA Validator Rules v1.6
qc: Submission-readiness review; package-level validation.

deliverable: ADRG finalization and cross-document consistency (SAP, Define-XML, ADRG, CSR)
description: One documented reconciliation that the SAP, Define-XML, ADRG and cSDRG, and CSR methods describe the same derivations, analysis sets and terminology versions, with the ADRG of record finalized after the check. It complements the numerical CSR-versus-TLF QC by checking methods-level wording.
inputs: Final SAP; Define-XML; ADRG and cSDRG; CSR methods text.
outputs: Cross-document consistency checklist; discrepancy resolutions; final ADRG.
standard: PHUSE ADRG Package; Define-XML v2.1; ICH E3
qc: Biostatistician sign-off; documented discrepancy closure.

deliverable: CSR Appendix 16.1.7: randomization scheme and codes
description: Appendix describing the randomization method and how it was carried out, including how random numbers were generated, with a table of randomization codes, participant identifiers and treatment assigned (by site for multicenter studies), released only after unblinding.
inputs: Randomization specification and schedule; randomization QC report; unblinding record; actual treatment received.
outputs: Appendix 16.1.7 text and table; cross-check of planned versus actual assignment.
standard: ICH E3; ICH E6(R3)
qc: Independent check of the appendix table against the master schedule and IRT assignments.

deliverable: ClinicalTrials.gov results data package
description: Statistics content for ClinicalTrials.gov results: participant flow, baseline characteristics, outcome measures matching the registered entries and adverse event tables, checked against the CSR. Phase 1 drug trials fall outside the definition of an applicable clinical trial in 42 CFR Part 11, so for them a results submission is voluntary and must then meet the conditions of 42 CFR 11.60.
inputs: Registered protocol information and outcome measures; QC-passed outputs or the CSR; sponsor disclosure policy.
outputs: Results data in the registry format; QC record of agreement with the CSR.
standard: 42 CFR Part 11; Food and Drug Administration Amendments Act of 2007,…
qc: Independent check of every posted number against the CSR or QC-passed outputs; outcome measures checked against the registration.

deliverable: EU CTR summary of results
description: Statistics content for the summary of results submitted to the EU database under Regulation (EU) No 536/2014: trial information including statistical methods, participant disposition, baseline characteristics, each protocol endpoint with its statistical analyses, adverse events and limitations. Article 37(4) applies irrespective of outcome and makes no exception for Phase 1 trials.
inputs: Protocol endpoints; QC-passed outputs or the CSR; date of the end of the trial in all Member States concerned.
outputs: Summary of results with Annex IV content submitted through the EU portal; QC record of agreement with the CSR.
standard: Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 of the European Parliament…; EMA/263067/2023
qc: Independent check of each value against the CSR or QC-passed outputs; endpoint list checked against the protocol.

deliverable: Lay summary of results: statistics review
description: Biostatistics review of the summary for laypersons that accompanies the EU summary of results, checking that numbers, adverse reaction frequencies and descriptions of overall results are correct, consistent with the technical summary and not overstated.
inputs: Draft lay summary; technical summary of results; CSR.
outputs: Statistics review comments and sign-off of the lay summary.
standard: Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 of the European Parliament…
qc: Every number traced to the technical summary; second reviewer for frequencies.

deliverable: TMF filing of biostatistics and programming records
description: Index and timely filing of the statistics records the TMF needs: sample-size calculations, randomization documents, SAP versions, analysis-set decisions, analysis datasets and programs, QC records and outputs, committee data and minutes, and system validation records, filed as each is finalized rather than at study end.
inputs: TMF plan and index; finalized statistics and programming records from every stage.
outputs: Statistics section of the TMF index with filing status; filed records with version, author, reviewer and approval details.
standard: ICH E6(R3); Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 of the European Parliament…
qc: Periodic completeness check against the index; QA spot-check of filed statistics records.

deliverable: Archiving of the analysis environment, programs, datasets and outputs
description: Final archive of locked datasets, analysis and QC programs, logs, outputs, software versions and environment records, so that every reported number can be regenerated, with access controls, a retention period set by the applicable regulations and documented transfer of ownership.
inputs: Locked SDTM and ADaM; final programs, logs and outputs; QC records; software and environment records; applicable retention requirements.
outputs: Archive package with manifest and checksums; archive record with location, access list and retention date.
standard: ICH E6(R3); Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 of the European Parliament…
qc: Restore test from the archive that regenerates selected outputs; QA review of the archive record.

deliverable: Statistics support for publications and data-sharing requests
description: Statistical review of manuscripts, abstracts and posters based on the study (numbers traced to the CSR, methods described as carried out, reporting-guideline items for crossover trials), and preparation of de-identified datasets and documentation when data sharing is agreed.
inputs: Final CSR and outputs; archived datasets; publication plan; data-sharing request and agreement.
outputs: Signed statistics review of each publication; de-identified dataset package with documentation where sharing is agreed; publications list for appendix 16.1.11 when available.
standard: ICH E3; ICH E8(R1); CONSORT crossover extension
qc: Number-by-number check against the CSR or archived outputs; independent review of de-identification.

deliverable: Preliminary-versus-final data reconciliation for escalation decisions
description: Comparison of the data used at each escalation review with the locked data and QC-passed outputs (participant counts, key adverse events, preliminary versus final PK parameters), stating whether any difference would have changed a decision. It feeds the CSR description of interim reviews.
inputs: Escalation decision log and archived package versions; final NCA parameters; final safety tables; locked database.
outputs: Reconciliation table and short memo; text for the CSR sections on dose selection and interim reviews.
standard: ICH E3
qc: Second reviewer checks each comparison against the archived package and the final outputs.
